name: React + Vite + TypeScript
description: Frontend governance for React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and modern-web-guidance accessibility/mobile checks.

evaluators.name: Frontend State, Hooks & Client Services Evaluator
evaluators.scope: Client state synchronization, hooks, promise deduplication, account-switch cleanup, and memory leaks.

evaluators.name: UI, Accessibility (modern-web-guidance) & Mobile Viewport Evaluator
evaluators.scope: Component DRYness, i18n parity, ARIA semantics, :focus-visible, mobile 320px-375px truncation, and background fetch priority.

pr_checklist: Audited UI/client changes with `modern-web-guidance` (ARIA, `:focus-visible`, `type="button"`, mobile text truncation)
Type check (`npm run lint`), unit tests (`npx vitest run --reporter=dot`), and build (`npm run build`) pass
agents_md_rules: **Frontend & Modern Web Guidance:** Whenever modifying HTML, CSS/Tailwind, React components, or client APIs, follow [`.agents/skills/frontend-react-vite/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/frontend-react-vite/SKILL.md) and run `modern-web-guidance` checks.

steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi
